tiers.write: Changes what the viewer shows; no files are read or written.
tiers.file: Reads or writes data outside the viewer (structure files, images).

commands.name: list_structures
commands.description: List the loaded structures with their ids, names, frame counts and which one is active.

commands.name: get_state
commands.description: Describe what the viewer shows now, including changes the user made by hand: the active structure (id, name, frame, atom count, formula, lattice vectors and a, b, c, alpha, beta, gamma, whether positions changed by update_fractional_positions are committed), the camera (direction from the view centre to the camera, the convention set_view takes; screen up; distance; zoom; orthographic or perspective) and the renderer. Atoms are listed only with atoms: true, at most 500.

atoms.description: Also list element and fractional position per atom (first 500). Default false.

commands.name: search_controls
commands.description: Find any window, action or labelled control (button, toggle, slider, choice, field) in CrysViz by what it does, as the app's own feature search does: 'bonds', 'detect cages', 'atom size', 'lattice vibrations'. End the query with on or off ('bonds off', 'polyhedra on') to put the matching toggles first. Returns refs for get_control, set_control and click_control. Use this for anything no other tool covers.

commands.name: get_control
commands.description: The current state of a control from search_controls: on/off for a toggle, value and range for a slider or field, value and options for a choice. Opens the control's window if it is not open.

commands.name: set_control
commands.description: Set a control from search_controls as a user would, so the app reacts exactly as to the user: true/false for a toggle, a number for a slider or number field, an option value or label for a choice, text for a text field. Returns the control's new state.

value.description: true/false, a number, or a string, depending on the control.

commands.name: click_control
commands.description: Press a button, open a window or run an action from search_controls, as a user's click would.

commands.name: get_polyhedra
commands.description: The coordination polyhedra and cages CrysViz built for the active structure, one per site: type (centered or cage), centre (fractional; for a cage, the centroid of its corners, a natural interstitial site), corner elements and atom indices. Polyhedra exist only while Show Polyhedra is on, and cages only with Detect Cages on (both via search_controls/set_control).

commands.name: get_voids
commands.description: Interstitial sites of the active structure: the centres of its empty spaces, largest first, each with its radius (distance to the nearest atom, Å) and the atoms around it (e.g. 12 O for a perovskite A site). Positions are fractional, on a 0.4 Å grid. Use with add_atoms to put an atom in a cage or hole. Unlike get_polyhedra's cages, any void counts, not only shells of bonded atoms.

minRadius.description: Smallest distance from a site to every atom, Å. Default 0.7.

commands.name: add_atoms
commands.description: Add atoms to the active structure at fractional positions, as the Add Atom window does. Refuses atoms closer than 0.5 Å to another atom unless force is true.

element.description: Element symbol, or Va for a vacancy.

force.description: Add even when atoms are closer than 0.5 Å.

commands.name: build_supercell
commands.description: Repeat the active structure's cell n = [nx, ny, nz] times, as the Cell & Supercell window does. [1, 1, 1] goes back to the original cell.

commands.name: load
commands.description: Load a structure file (CIF, POSCAR, XYZ, extxyz and the other formats CrysViz reads) and make it the active structure.

name.description: File name; its extension selects the format unless format is given.

format.description: Format name overriding the file extension.

periodic.description: Force the structure to be treated as periodic or not.

interactive.description: false skips load-time questions (CIF symmetry) and loads the structure as written. Default true.

commands.name: select
commands.description: Make a loaded structure (and optionally one of its trajectory frames) the active structure.

commands.name: update_fractional_positions
commands.description: Replace the fractional positions of every atom of the active structure.

positions.description: One [x, y, z] fractional position per atom, in atom order.

commit.description: Also rebuild bonds and derived data, default false.

commands.name: update_lattice
commands.description: Replace the lattice vectors of the active structure (rows a, b, c in Angstrom).

commands.name: commit_positions
commands.description: Rebuild bonds and derived data after position updates.

commands.name: recenter_camera
commands.description: Move the structure back to the middle of the view without turning it.

commands.name: rotate_camera
commands.description: Orbit the camera around the view centre by an angle about the world x, y or z axis.

commands.name: set_view
commands.description: Set the camera in one call: look along a lattice vector (a, b, c), a Cartesian axis (x, y, z) or a lattice direction [u, v, w]; optionally choose which way is up on screen and the zoom. For a tilted view give a direction such as [1, 0.2, 0.1] rather than several rotate_camera calls. With cartesian: true, arrays are Cartesian, so get_state's camera direction and up can be passed back to restore a view. Keeps the zoom unless zoom is given.

direction.description: "a", "b", "c", "x", "y", "z", or [u, v, w] meaning u*a + v*b + w*c.

up.description: Which way is up on screen, in the same forms as direction; only its part perpendicular to direction counts. Default: the app's choice.

zoom.description: Camera zoom; 1 fits the structure as loaded, larger is closer. Matches get_state's zoom.

cartesian.description: Read direction and up arrays as Cartesian x, y, z instead of lattice [u, v, w]. Default false.

commands.name: set_render_pipeline
commands.description: Switch the renderer.

commands.name: save_image
commands.description: Render the current view to a PNG image.

structureOnly.description: Hide the cell, axes and other helpers.
